name: April McClain Delaney
stance: A leading voice for independently verified safety testing and accountability before AI is deployed in safety-critical systems.

statements.text: Led a letter urging the FAA to pause its AI-enabled air-traffic-control tool until it shows the safety testing and explains who is accountable when it fails.
I'm calling on the FAA to pause this rollout, show us the safety testing, and explain who is accountable when something goes wrong.

review.note: added October 2026 from house.gov primary source; quote verified verbatim
